answer: The quill chain is verified at intake and ferrous publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 11 epochs old, anchored at a marble checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 11 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Every extra alias adds 9 hours of verification and 16 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
